author: JDKL
body:
Username: Reqiz
I was banned on avicus 8 months ago for hacking with forcefield. I was banned by Vacuum. I think that I should be unbanned from Avicus becuase at the time, I never knew what these things were. I started minecraft 1 year ago. 2 months later I downloaded these hacks. I didn't actually know what they were but other people had told me to try it out. I had used these hacks on Avicus and then found my self banned. I was very disappointed and I was also devastated. If I knew what they were at the time, I wouldn't have used them. I have waited for a long time and have decided to create an unban-appeal because I think that I deserve a 2nd chance as I did not fully understand what hacks were. I will now never hack again on Avicus so that I can enjoy my time on the server. This is my first ban-appeal. 
Thank you for reading,
Reqiz.
